en-US.description: Mullvad Browser is a privacy-focused web browser developed in collaboration between Mullvad VPN and the Tor Project. It's produced to minimize tracking and fingerprinting.
en-US.longDescription: When you visit a website, you can be identified and tracked through your IP address, third-party cookies, all kinds of tracking scripts, and through so called browser fingerprints. That’s why masking your IP address is not enough to stop the data collection. However, by using a trustworthy VPN in combination with a privacy-focused browser, you can put up a better resistance against the mass surveillance of today. That's why we partnered with the Tor Project to develop Mullvad Browser – a browser designed to minimize tracking and fingerprints.

zh-CN.description: Mullvad 浏览器是一款注重隐私保护的网络浏览器，由 Mullvad VPN 与 Tor Project 联合开发。它可以最大程度地减少跟踪和指纹收集。
zh-CN.longDescription: 当您访问网站时，可以通过您的 IP 地址、第三方 Cookie、各种跟踪脚本以及所谓的浏览器指纹来识别和跟踪您。这就是隐藏您的 IP 地址并不足以停止数据收集的原因。不过，将值得信赖的 VPN 与注重隐私的浏览器相结合，可以更好地抵御当今的大规模监控。这就是我们与 Tor Project 合作开发 Mullvad 浏览器的原因，这款浏览器旨在最大限度地减少跟踪和指纹。
